Select compounds tested against human Pim-1 kinase with IC50 values. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Join docs on activities.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter by target name 'Pim-1 kinase' and organism 'Homo sapiens' and standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
